parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const channel=b.channel??'unknown'; const external=b.external_message_id??b.message_id??`${channel}:${b.conversation_id??''}:${b.timestamp??Date.now()}`; return [{json:{organization_slug:b.organization_slug??'default',channel,contact:{external_id:b.contact?.external_id??b.from??'',name:b.contact?.name??null,phone:b.contact?.phone??b.from??null,email:b.contact?.email??null},conversation_external_id:b.conversation_id??b.chat_id??b.from??'',message:{direction:'in',type:b.message_type??'text',text:b.text??b.transcript??'',payload:b,provider_message_id:b.external_message_id??b.message_id??null},idempotency_key:b.idempotency_key??external,received_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.query: WITH org AS (SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE slug=$1 LIMIT 1), c AS (INSERT INTO contacts(organization_id,external_id,name,phone,email) SELECT id,$2,$3,$4,$5 FROM org ON CONFLICT(organization_id,external_id) DO UPDATE SET name=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name,contacts.name),phone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone,contacts.phone),email=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email,contacts.email),updated_at=now() RETURNING id,organization_id), conv AS (INSERT INTO conversations(organization_id,contact_id,channel,external_id,last_message_at) SELECT organization_id,id,$6,$7,now() FROM c ON CONFLICT(organization_id,channel,external_id) DO UPDATE SET last_message_at=now(),updated_at=now() RETURNING id,organization_id) INSERT INTO messages(organization_id,conversation_id,direction,message_type,body,payload,provider_message_id,idempotency_key) SELECT organization_id,id,'in',$8,$9,$10::jsonb,$11,$12 FROM conv ON CONFLICT(organization_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING *;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.organization_slug, $json.contact.external_id, $json.contact.name || null, $json.contact.phone || null, $json.contact.email || null, $json.channel, $json.conversation_external_id, $json.message.type, $json.message.text || null, JSON.stringify($json.message.payload || {}), $json.message.provider_message_id || null, $json.idempotency_key] }}
